text:
taylor-cs: FYI — Acme sent over a SOC2 evidence request. They specifically want KMS rotation proofs, RBAC change logs, an SBOM for our customer-facing package, and an ETA for remediation on a transitive CVE. They asked for answers by EOD next Tue.

maria-seceng: can you paste the exact questionnaire or at least the sections they called out? which CVE id?

taylor-cs: attached PDF link: https://acme.example/soc2-ask.pdf (uploaded). CVE is CVE-2026-0456 (transitive via package foo-bar v2.1.0). They highlighted KMS key rotation dates and service-account RBAC changes in the last 12 months.

maria-seceng: thanks. initial thoughts: KMS rotation — we have rotation records in KMS audit logs for the managed keys used by private deployments. RBAC — must pull Cloud IAM audit logs and our internal change tickets. SBOM — our build pipeline can generate an SPDX JSON for the deployed artifact.

sam-platform: I can export the RBAC deltas and add ticket references. For KMS, which key material do they want? customer-managed key or Redwood-managed?

taylor-cs: they asked for proof of rotation for the key used to encrypt customer data in Dedicated for Acme (they use a customer-managed key).

maria-seceng: ok that means we need HSM/KMS rotation entries + KMS policy snapshots. alex-sre — can you pull the cloud KMS audit events for the key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-efgh for the last 12 months and export to a csv with event, principal, and timestamp?

alex-sre: on it. quick note: retention for cloud audit logs is 13 months in prod; I'll do a narrow export. command I'm running: `gcloud logging read \"resource.type=kms_key AND protoPayload.methodName=\\\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyRingService.UpdateCryptoKey\\\"\" --project=redwood-prod --format=json` (we also have AWS CloudTrail for that key).

maria-seceng: for the CVE triage — did we see any exploit or customer impact?

taylor-cs: Acme reported that their internal dependency scanner flagged it; they haven't observed exploit behavior. They want prioritization info and a patch timeline.

maria-seceng: ok prioritized plan: 1) verify if foo-bar v2.1.0 is actually in our runtime SBOM for the Dedicated image used by Acme (if present => high priority). 2) if present, engineer patch candidate (backport to our 1.2.x line) and run CI tests and canary. 3) provide hotfix + coordination notes to customer. I estimate discovery and SBOM confirmation by EOD today, patch candidate next 48 hours, canary next 72-96 hours after that.

sam-platform: CI pipeline can produce an SPDX SBOM artifact. CI job: `./ci/generate_sbom.sh --image=dedicated-acme:1.2.3 --format=spdx` — I can kick that and attach the artifact. CI will also run `snyk test` and `oss-scan` to verify transitive presence.

ci-bot: Build #5421 triggered: generate_sbom(dedicated-acme:1.2.3) — artifact: gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/5421/spdx.json

alex-sre: exported KMS rotation events for the key — uploading to secure bucket now: `gs://redwood-compliance/acme/keys/rotation-1899991234.csv` — contains 4 rotation events, principals trimmed for PII.

maria-seceng: good. sam, can you also pull RBAC change logs covering service accounts `svc-redwood-*` for the same 12mo window and include ticket links? we need evidence of who approved changes.

sam-platform: will do. note: some older approvals are in Confluence and a JIRA project that has cross-references; I'll include screenshots and ticket IDs.

taylor-cs: customer asked for a single bundle (signed manifest + artifacts) and a short remediation timeline statement. can we commit to when we can deliver the bundle?

maria-seceng: commit: SBOM confirmation + KMS rotation CSV + RBAC exports + brief remediation plan in one bundle by 48 hours from now (EOD +2). For the CVE patch ETA: if foo-bar is present, patch candidate in 48 hours, canary within 96 hours after candidate.

legal-ops: pls ensure bundle excludes any raw PII keys or full principal identities. send sanitized evidence and baseline statement from Legal for SOC2 phrasing.

maria-seceng: will sanitize exports and include a legal-approved statement. I'll drop the bundle link here when ready.

taylor-cs: thanks all — forwarding to Acme and asking them to confirm if 48 hours works. I'll update thread with their reply. :thumbsup:

maria-seceng: tagging @sam-platform and @alex-sre for action items. will post follow-up checklist once SBOM artifact and CSVs are attached.

[END THREAD]
